description: Vulnerable fixture where Azure Storage network, TLS, public access, soft delete, and encryption controls look acceptable but Shared Key, SAS, listkeys, revocation, and diagnostics are ungoverned.

storage_accounts.name: sensitiveexports
storage_accounts.evidence_overcredit: Reviewer marked storage acceptable from private endpoint, Deny network rule, TLS, CMK, and soft delete only.

expected_gate_results.evidence: Authorization inventory is missing even though storage was passed from network and encryption controls.
Shared Key remains enabled for sensitive storage with no scoped exception.
Resource-group Contributor path can list account keys without PIM, approval, or monitoring.
Account SAS is broad and long-lived; service SAS has unknown expiry, protocol, consumer, and revocation path.
SAS expiration policy is Log only with no transition to Block.
No stored access policy or tested emergency revocation path is documented.
No diagnostics route for key/SAS use, SasExpiryStatus, failed auth, or StorageRead/Write/Delete events.
Generated/manual SAS evidence is incomplete and must not be counted as Pass.

expected_assessment.finding: Storage account hardening is over-credited while Shared Key, SAS, listkeys, revocation, and diagnostics are ungoverned.
